summary: Kanzhun Ltd filed a Form 6-K attaching a Next Day Disclosure Return under HKEX rules, detailing ongoing share repurchases for cancellation. Between May 27 and June 22, 2026, the company repurchased 9,931,656 Class A ordinary shares at prices ranging from USD 6.6721 to USD 7.2478 per share, reflecting a capital return program. The repurchases are executed through open-market transactions and are set for cancellation, reducing outstanding share count. The filing lists share price paid per batch and percentage reductions. Watch for continued repurchase activity as the company returns capital to shareholders, potentially boosting EPS and signaling management confidence.
